_comment: Add a new subject by copying a block. region id = subject id (science/compsci/...). Each zone: zone (order int), name, topic (unique key used by /api/content/questions), minLevel, theme (what to teach), diff (easy|medium|hard), ageBand, and mons[] = the Pokémon catchable in that zone (deterministic gameplay mapping, pick dex from redesign-plan/03b-roster.csv). The generator writes questions+knowledge; this file drives regions/zones/pokemon.

zones.name: Padang Bilangan
zones.theme: Bilangan & operasi: penjumlahan/pengurangan/perkalian/pembagian, urutan operasi sederhana, faktor & kelipatan.

zones.name: Lembah Pecahan
zones.theme: Pecahan & desimal: membandingkan pecahan, pecahan senilai, mengubah pecahan ke desimal, operasi pecahan sederhana.
